title: Nearly Linear Private Learning of Littlestone Classes
abstract: arXiv:2610.23160v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Differentially private learning aims to learn from data while protecting individual training examples. For binary classification, finite Littlestone dimension characterizes approximate private PAC learnability (Alon et al., JACM 2022). Understanding how this dimension controls private sample complexity remains a central question. For classes of Littlestone dimension $d$, the first general upper bound was doubly exponential in $d$ (Bun, Livni, and Moran, FOCS 2020). Subsequent work improved this to $\widetilde O(d^6)$ (Ghazi et al., STOC 2021) and then to $\widetilde O(d^5)$ (Lyu, STOC 2026). We prove a nearly linear upper bound of $O(d\log d)$.   Our main algorithmic contribution is a structural exponential mechanism for data-dependent candidate sets equipped with a rank satisfying suitable stability conditions. translated_title: Littlestone类的近乎线性隐私学习
translated_abstract: 差分隐私学习旨在从数据中学习的同时保护个体训练样本。对于二分类问题，有限的Littlestone维数刻画了近似隐私PAC可学习性（Alon等，JACM 2022）。理解该维数如何控制隐私样本复杂度仍然是一个核心问题。对于Littlestone维数为 $d$ 的类，第一个一般性上界是 $d$ 的双指数级（Bun、Livni和Moran，FOCS 2020）。后续工作将其改进至 $\widetilde O(d^6)$（Ghazi等，STOC 2021），随后又改进至 $\widetilde O(d^5)$（Lyu，STOC 2026）。我们证明了近乎线性的上界 $O(d\log d)$。我们的主要算法贡献是一种针对数据相关候选集的结构化指数机制，该机制配备有满足适当稳定性条件的秩。对于诸如子空间指示器等自然的Littlestone类，该秩具有简单的几何解释：它是余维数（原文此处被截断）。
tldr: 该论文将Littlestone维数为 $d$ 的类在差分隐私PAC学习中的样本复杂度上界从此前最好的 $\widetilde O(d^5)$ 大幅改进为近乎线性的 $O(d\log d)$，其核心技术贡献是一种针对数据相关候选集、配备满足稳定性条件的秩的结构化指数机制。
en_tdlr: This paper improves the best known upper bound on the private sample complexity of learning Littlestone classes of dimension $d$ from $\widetilde O(d^5)$ to a nearly linear $O(d\log d)$, via a structural exponential mechanism for data-dependent candidate sets equipped with a rank satisfying suitable stability conditions.
